title: Hawynveil
safeHtml:
'''Hawynveil''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central South Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-11.

History

According to Histrocial Documents, there used to be two large families in the Brighton Hall area who had bitter rivalries with each other, with one being the Poon Family who helped create the namesake of Brighton Hall, and the other being the Wan Family. Eventually, the Wan Family lost the rivalry, and escaped to the area that is now known as Holborn Garden. In order to leave proof of existance of the Wan Family, as well as to leave a veil of deception over the true origins of the name, a Welsh-sounding name "Hawynveil" was used. The name of "Holborn Garden" also originated from one of the Wan Family Elders, Holborn Wan.

Hawynveil has one of the highest proportions of private housing in any Sub-District of Asylum at 47%. This was due to the fact that this area was adjacent to the southernmost exit of Route 3, and the convenience of Road Transport also attracted many potential buyers.

Future Development

The current developer of Asylum will continue to collaborate with the developer of Coopol regarding Fubuki development, and has also considered the possibility of Additional Housing along the border of the two Districts.

title: High Speed Railway
safeHtml:
''' (Formally named Nazca Railway Terracept Division High Speed Railway)''' was the Intercity Rail system of NR. It was established on October 16 2013 alongside Austrumcept Terminal. At the time of the closure of Terracept Division, there was only one Line in operation.

Facilities

For each station, there would be an arrival hall and a departure hall. As their names suggest, the departure hall is used for passengers entering high speed railway trains, whereas the arrival hall is for passengers arriving at the high speed railway station. Departure Halls feature a cafe and a luggage drop-off area, with a map that highlights the entire High Speed Railway system and instructs the passengers which platform to board to go to a certain destination.

On the other hand, the arrival hall features conveyor belts at which passengers could collect their luggage in a fashion similar to airport arrival halls.

Fun Facts

  • While only one line was ever established between and , as there are 10 platforms and 6 platforms dedicated to the for the former and latter respectively, it could be implied that this system was expected to undergo large-scale expansions and involve more stations.
